# CPA Manager Plus extraction: config.json and environment

> **Last verified:** 2026-10-20 — patched Manager Plus 1.14.7 measures 28
> config.json keys, `defaultTheme` with its values, and 33 environment variables
> through the shared Go test extractor.

## Two surfaces

Manager Plus reads `config.json` (from `CPA_MANAGER_CONFIG`, else next to the
binary) and environment variables, which take precedence over it. The raw has
one fact per surface, each declared in `extracted/facts.json` as an opaque
`object` measured on Linux, because the shape is host-independent.

`config` reflects the unexported `fileConfig` struct, which `config.json`
decodes into, over its `json` tags. Node types and the path grammar are the
shared ones from `lib/extracted/go/nat_shared_test.go`. A field whose type has
its own JSON decoder fails extraction: nothing probes such decoders yet.
`defaultTheme`, which `patches/default-theme.patch` adds, also carries `enum`:
the loader's `defaultThemes`, so the option takes only values the server loads.
The extractor names that variable, so a release without the patch fails to
compile it.

`environment` comes from `go/ast` over the non-test files of the
`apps/manager-server` module that the Linux build compiles, functions and
methods alike, because the variable names are string constants passed to
helpers, not struct fields. A function that passes its parameter to `os.Getenv`
or `os.LookupEnv`, or to another such function, forwards it; each call passing a
constant there reads that variable. A non-constant name, and `os.Environ`, fail
extraction. Each node has:

- `type`: `string`, as every environment value is, so the shared classifier sees
  the names.
- `readBy`: the reading functions, which say how the value is parsed
  (`config.envInt` for a positive integer, `config.envBool` for a switch,
  `config.hasEnv` for presence).
- `configKeys`: the `config.json` keys the read falls back to, measured only
  inside the config package. They are the `fileConfig` fields a forwarder call's
  other arguments select, directly or through a local variable assigned from
  them; for a direct read, the arguments callers pass the reading function.
- `description`: the row in the operations guide's environment table
  (`apps/docs/en/operations/manager-server.md`). A row naming a variable no code
  reads fails extraction; a read without a row, `CPAMP_UPDATE_CHECK_ENABLED`,
  has no description.

Not measured: value ranges and defaults (`collectorMode` values,
`usageArchiveRetentionDays` bounds), the derived paths Manager Plus computes
(`usage-archives`, `data.key` under the data directory), and the
`/run/secrets/*` key file defaults.

## Credentials

`config.json` names key files (`managementKeyFile`, `adminKeyFile`,
`dataKeyFile`), never keys. `extract/annotations.json` gives credential reasons
for the three environment variables that carry a key itself, and
`extract/rules.nix` reconciles them through the shared `reconcile`. The config
surface has no rows, so a credential-shaped key added upstream fails until it
gets one.

## Checks and updates

`cpa-manager-plus-extracted` compares the fresh extraction with the committed
facts and checks annotation reconciliation. Regenerate from the repository root:

```bash
nix run .#checks.x86_64-linux.cpa-manager-plus-extracted.passthru.regenerate
```

The package's update script calls the shared `regenCommand` through
`mkGoUpdateExtract.extraAfter`, so a release bump carries its new shape before
publication.

# CPA Manager Plus typed settings

> **Last verified:** 2026-10-20 — 28 config.json keys and 32 environment
> variables give the settings type through `lib/extracted/options.nix`; the
> render loads through patched Manager Plus 1.14.7's
> `LoadWithoutCreatingDefault`; `config.defaultTheme` reaches the panel through
> `/usage-service/info`; `ai.cpa-manager-plus.instances` renders it at start and
> applies `config.adminKeyFile` through `reset-admin-key` on every start;
> evaluation resolves the database from declared, clean paths, and the run
> script unsets inherited admin-key and database variables.

`lib/default.nix` exports
`cpa-manager-plus.{settingsType, render, report, exclusions, sample}`. One
generated tree holds both surfaces: `config` is config.json and `environment`
the variables Manager Plus reads, from `extract/rules.nix`'s reconciled entries.
The shared rules are in `dev/fragments/extracted/typed-settings.md`.

## Secrets live in the environment

config.json names key files, never keys, so its render lifts nothing. The keys
are the three annotated variables `CPA_MANAGEMENT_KEY`, `CPA_MANAGER_ADMIN_KEY`
and `CPA_MANAGER_DATA_KEY`, typed as redact references. An instance takes its
admin key from `config.adminKeyFile` instead (Instances, Admin key). Every other
variable is a string, as Manager Plus reads it; `readBy` and `configKeys` are
prose the type does not carry (`unread`).

`render settings` gives `{ content; secrets; environment; }`: config.json as
JSON text, and the set variables, nulls dropped, ready for an option of type
`redact.types.environment`. `CPA_MANAGER_CONFIG` is excluded: the launcher
points it at the rendered config.json.

## Check

`cpa-manager-plus-settings` evaluates `sample` through `settingsType`, passes
the rendered environment through `redact.types.environment`, and runs
`checks/settings_test.go` in `internal/config`. It decodes the config into
`fileConfig` with unknown keys refused (the loader ignores them), sets the
environment with a dummy for each reference, and calls
`LoadWithoutCreatingDefault`; `CPA_MANAGEMENT_KEY` must reach the loaded config.
The one override, `USAGE_ARCHIVE_RETENTION_DAYS = "30"`, is a variable the
loader parses as an integer and refuses otherwise.

## Instances

`ai.cpa-manager-plus.instances.<name>` (`modules/instances.nix`, through
`packages/ai-module/lib/instances.nix`) runs Manager Plus as the service
`cpa-manager-plus-<name>`. `port` (18317) fixes `config.httpAddr` to
`127.0.0.1:<port>`, where the native default binds every interface; `stateDir`
fixes `config.dataDir`, which Manager Plus otherwise resolves next to the
rendered config in the launcher's runtime directory. The rendered environment
becomes the service's. `upstream` names an `ai.cliproxyapi.instances` entry and
defaults `config.cpaUpstreamUrl` to its loopback origin and `CPA_MANAGEMENT_KEY`
to its `management.secret-key` reference; a missing or disabled one fails an
assertion.

### Admin key

Manager Plus reads its admin key only while its database holds no admin
credential (`internal/service/bootstrap/service.go`, `ensureAdminCredential`);
after the first start a changed key is ignored. An instance with
`config.adminKeyFile`, an absolute path, applies it on every start instead: the
run script calls `cpa-manager-plus reset-admin-key --admin-key-file <file>`
before it execs the server. Without `--db-path` the command loads the same
config and environment the server does (its `resolveDBPath`), so it resets the
database the server opens. The command refuses a missing or empty database, so a
start without one is a first start. The run script tells the two apart by
testing the database evaluation resolves as `config.go` `LoadWithOptions` does:
`environment.USAGE_DB_PATH`, then `<environment.USAGE_DATA_DIR>/usage.sqlite`,
then `config.dbPath`, then `<config.dataDir>/usage.sqlite`,
`<stateDir>/usage.sqlite` by default. Each of these, when set, must be an
absolute path with no empty, `.` or `..` segment and no trailing whitespace, or
evaluation fails: Manager Plus cleans paths lexically (`filepath.Join`) and
trims Unicode whitespace (`strings.TrimSpace`), so only such a path is the one
it opens. The run script unsets `USAGE_DB_PATH` and `USAGE_DATA_DIR` unless the
instance declares them, so a value inherited from the user manager's environment
cannot move the database. A first start seeds the credential from the same file,
and the run script fails first if that file is unreadable or blank, where
Manager Plus would generate a key and log it. A failed reset fails the start.
The path is a restart trigger (`restartOnChange`), so a changed file restarts
the instance onto the new key, and on Linux Home Manager the unit orders after
the secret providers, as one reading a redact reference does. Only the path
reaches argv and the store; the command prints no key.

`environment.CPA_MANAGER_ADMIN_KEY` and `CPA_MANAGER_ADMIN_KEY_FILE` fail an
assertion that names `config.adminKeyFile`. Either one takes precedence over
`adminKeyFile` (`readSecret`) and would be read on the first start only, and the
plain key could reach `reset-admin-key` only through argv or a copy on disk. The
run script unsets both before the reset and the server, so an inherited value
cannot seed a first start either. Without any of the three, the run script
resets nothing, as before.

## Default theme

Manager Plus 1.14.7 has no server theme setting. The web store
(`apps/web/src/stores/useThemeStore.ts`) defaults `theme` to `auto`, which
follows `prefers-color-scheme`, and persists the user's pick in localStorage. A
browser that reports light to every page and clears site data on close, as
Firefox does with anti-fingerprinting on, always gets light.
`patches/default-theme.patch` adds `config.defaultTheme`. The package applies it
to `src` itself with `--fuzz=0`, so the build, the extractor and the checks all
read the patched tree; it changes neither `package-lock.json` nor `go.mod`, so
`npmDepsHash` and `vendorHash` are unchanged.

- `internal/config/config.go`: `auto` when unset, else `dark` or `white`, the
  web app's `Theme` values (`apps/web/src/types/common.ts`). Any other value
  fails `LoadWithOptions`. No environment variable sets it.
- `internal/service/setup/service.go`: `Info`, served unauthenticated at
  `/usage-service/info`, returns it. The panel already calls that endpoint
  before login (`LoginPage.tsx`, `ProtectedRoute.tsx`). Writing the value into
  `management.html` was rejected: `internal/service/panel/service.go` serves the
  embedded or `panelPath` bytes through `http.ServeContent`, so a rewrite would
  be a second channel with its own caching. The cost is one request at load, and
  a light first frame until the answer arrives.
- `apps/web`: `AppLifecycle.tsx` asks once at start unless the user has chosen,
  and `applyDefaultTheme` applies a valid answer. The store records `chosen`:
  `setTheme` (theme menu, login toggle) sets it and the default never does, so a
  changed `defaultTheme` still reaches a browser that never chose. Stored state
  moves to version 1. A version 0 `white` or `dark` counts as chosen and a
  version 0 `auto` does not, because 1.14.7's `initializeTheme` wrote `auto`
  back on every load.

Unset, the server reports `auto` and the panel behaves as upstream, apart from
the one request. A panel served by plain CPA has no such endpoint and keeps its
theme. `module-service-instances-real-daemons` starts the patched server unset
and with `dark`, reads `defaultTheme` back from `/usage-service/info`, and finds
the reader in the served panel. `cpa-manager-plus-settings` runs the patch's
`TestLoadDefaultTheme`, and the web build runs its `useThemeStore.test.ts`.
